report.summary: Patient P-D003 (67F, Original Medicare + Part D, no transport benefit) screens positive for transportation difficulty but no current utility shutoff risk. Lives in a low-income tract (17031440201) where 37.5% of households lack a vehicle and area utility shutoff rate is 21.5%. Has a cardiology appointment 10/16 at 11:00; transit feasibility could not be verified (no facility location on file). Medicare provides no transport benefit, so Medicaid Ride Line is not applicable.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM-5 PM. Patient is 67 and age-eligible. Call to schedule in advance of the 10/16 cardiology appointment.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days. Best as a longer-term option given the 10/16 appointment is sooner.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Medicaid plan members only — call number on card at least 2 business days ahead. Patient has Original Medicare (no Medicaid), so likely NOT eligible.

options.name: Shutoff Prevention Clinic
options.how_to_access: Walk-in help with disconnection notices, Tuesdays. No current shutoff risk per screener, but useful if a notice arises.

options.name: Neighborhood Energy Help
options.how_to_access: Income-based help with gas and electric bills. Apply in person Mon/Wed. Verify income eligibility at visit.

options.name: Lakeside Energy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Energy assistance program. Use the referral tracking link (filled with record number) when submitting a referral.
